social_vertical.notes: max_base_caption_width is deliberately conservative for a full multi-word phrase at rest so it still peaks safely at Balloon's 124%. isolated_word_safe_width is the real measured safe corridor at the anchor row (eroded by interior_padding_px, symmetric around caption_anchor.x: left=51/right=874 at the reference canvas) — for a single unbreakable token with no line-mates (an oversized German compound, or a solo word), which does not need the multi-word margin and can use the real bound directly.
